Name: Buy cooking recipes - fix
Author: cyxyr
Description:
I like to enjoy watching Queen Of Sauce on TV, this mod is just to prevent missing TV shows
[b]Tips[/b]：In 1.6, you can buy the all Queen Of Sauce recipes book to unlock all  TV recipes。

[color=#ff0000]This mod can purchase all recipes (no conditions required)  as long as the mod author puts custom recipe into this file (data/recipes) .[/color]

[size=3][b]compatibility:  [color=#ff0000]SVE RSV
[/color][/b][/size]

Link to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1126] original work
[/url]﻿

[size=3][b]Update [/b][/size][size=3][b]unofficial.3[/b]
[/size]
 allow you to buy recipes from Pierre's shop.







[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=2][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]

[size=5]Use[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Open the SMAPI console[/size]
[*][size=2]In SMAPI,Type 'buyrecipe "recipe name" and press enter  or buy recipes from Pierre's shop[/size]
[*][size=2]在SMAPI中，输入 ‘[b]buyrecipe "配方名字"[/b]  并按enter键。或者从皮埃尔商店购买[/size]
[/list]
